g.text: Ten steps from the BA's first notes to approved test cases. Each has an agent that drafts it, a file that holds it, a command that
checks it, and a person who approves it. Steps that don't apply are skipped.

g.text: approved by the tester and BA
The Spec Explorer serves steps 4 to 6 when an upstream's spec is new: its digest says where the BA's data is.
At any point, the Requirements Analyst, or bridge-kit work status, says where the requirement stands and which step is next.
